name: smoking_not_friends
about: Smoking Behind the Supermarket story Short: an old colleague teases Sasaki about the woman in his life; he can't say what they are - not acquaintances, not quite friends, a thing that could fizzle out any moment - but whenever he's hunched over in shame she tells him it's no big deal and pushes him back up straight. The drop runs their evenings out back; he ends admitting she's important to him.
anime: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You

story.why: oh? there's a she? didn't realize you had a woman in your life
not just acquaintances, not close friends - a gust of wind could blow it away; but that girl lifts me up when I'm broken down, she keeps me going

outro.why: so she must be quite important to you. - Yes.

title: They're Not Even Friends... But She's The Reason He Keeps Going
hook: Sasaki can't say what he and Tayama are - not acquaintances, not quite friends. But whenever he's ashamed, she's the one who tells him it's no big deal.
